authentication: Trusted gateway resolves identity from an authenticated provider call; never from model arguments.

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Return up to three available owner-offered meeting slots. Availability is checked, not a booking.

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Book an offered slot only after the recipient explicitly confirms it. Claim booked only on a booked receipt.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Record what the recipient said. Do not infer intent; never claim a booking through this tool.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Record an explicitly confirmed future callback date/time with timezone. This is a request, not a promise of a scheduled call.

tools.name: opt_out
tools.description: Record an opt-out immediately, then end the call. Do not continue pitching.

limitations: Provider configuration read back; audio tool execution remains UNVERIFIED.
Private header authentication plus provider lookup; no HMAC verification.
Browser calls cannot modify live leads; controlled test binding remains pending.
